title: Add isolated Korea branch preview deployment
purpose: Make renewal review accessible at a separate HTTPS branch URL without production writes

production_safety.operational_data: No live operational rows are read or changed. Read infrastructure manifests, routing and role grants only. Preview DB is seeded from committed public source fixtures; isolated QA is read for regression evidence.
production_safety.schema_migration: No production schema migration. New branch DB contains only Page and SiteSetting read models with public data.
external_side_effects: Build and run one resource-limited preview container on existing AWS, create its read-only DB/login and add one HTTPS host. No new paid service, production app replacement, external messages or SMTP credentials. Git push does not trigger deployment automatically.

verification.command: pnpm --filter korea build; pnpm --filter korea typecheck
verification.evidence: Preview-mode source builds and typechecks; output/korea-preview-build.log.
5 deployment safety tests pass; actual source fixture generation is bounded to 152 public board posts.
3 runtime checks pass: notice/noindex, no inquiry insert and no article counter write; output/korea-preview-integration.json.

residual_risks: Existing server CPU, RAM and storage are shared; each preview container is capped at 384MB and 0.75 CPU. More branches consume additional existing capacity.
This adds explicit commit deployment at stable branch URLs, not a push listener or GitHub Actions integration.
External DNS and certificate issuance must succeed during activation; prior Caddy configuration is retained for rollback.
